environment: Arch Linux 7.1.9-arch1-2, Rust 1.98.1, debug test process
provider: deterministic synthetic provider, 250 ms content delay; no Graph/OAuth/internet
limitations: This simulates thumbnail-style reads; it does not run Nautilus thumbnailers.
Metadata is already indexed; no real-provider delay or credential refresh is included.
Local filesystem tests ran concurrently in this process; repeat timings can differ.
The metadata sample directory contains one file; the separate latency benchmark covers 525 entries.
